request.prompt: A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest. Its paws crunch softly in fresh snow, with gentle wind and distant birds chirping. Natural soft daylight, realistic motion, clear synchronized ambient sound.

precision: Original INT8 ConvRot codes / FP32 scales, BF16 boundaries, RNE127 activation quantization; PrunaVAED BF16 with strict FP32 TensorOps accumulation
method: One complete warm-up per arm, then ABBA/BAAB; fresh CLI process per sample; common conditioning cache; compare outputs after timing
conditioning: Fresh isolated conditioning directory, first candidate is a prompt-cache miss; one full warmup per arm then ABBA. All following requests hit connected conditioning. Process/shader/OS caches are not forced cold. No concurrent agent benchmark/build/test during timing.
ablation: Same packaged CLI and all prior defaults; only TURBOCIDER_PRUNAVAED_OPTIMIZED_INPUT_LOADS=0 versus 1. This does not measure all historical optimizations against stock.

media_validation.scope: Full BGRA video and PCM16 audio decode using AVFoundation after all timings; equality is for this fixed seed/request, not a cross-prompt perceptual study.

checks.command: make test remaining recipes (exact 43-command suffix from test-streaming-contract through test_inventory.py)
Five actual packaged DiT block cases versus V22

make_test_execution.completed_prefix: All make test recipes through test-streaming-host passed. test-streaming-contract failed at direct C++ adapter linkage because the local incremental helper omitted canonical default symbol visibility for ltx_session.mm.
make_test_execution.repair: Rebuilt with canonical symbol visibility; no runtime source logic change. Also removed an extra EOF blank line before the final rebuild.
make_test_execution.remaining_recipe_source: Exact unmodified suffix of Makefile test recipe, starting with test-streaming-contract; generated /tmp/tc-ltx-release-resume.mk.

e2e.method: ABBA after candidate-first cache-miss warmup and baseline warmup

connector.scope: real-weight single connector block per process, first call excluded, 4 balanced ABBA/BAAB rounds and 10 warmed calls per process; exact BF16 outputs; not whole-video throughput

dit.scope: native original block16 coefficients, real connected text, synthetic BF16 hidden states; one block per process; excluded first call then ten warm calls per arm; balanced fresh-process ABBA/BAAB four quartets; serial AV performance only, fast AV correctness tested separately; no full video/step timing
workspace+QK fusion vs V20 FFN-only workspace policy

vae.scope: Native C++ header qualification against the exact frozen V22 header, one convolution per process.
vae.method: original BF16 coefficients; deterministic synthetic BF16 input at actual decoder geometry; two excluded warmups then four balanced ABBA/BAAB quartets with five repeated calls per arm sample; full output byte comparison and fifteen FP64 boundary witnesses after all timing; not whole decoder/video
vae.default_policy: native admitted TensorOps BF16 shapes only, CO<=CI; 1024/1024 grouped scalar input reads, otherwise aligned vec4 with GPU fallback for non-eight-byte-aligned views; expanding projections preserve scalar reads
vae.limitation: single-operator results, not whole decoder or video speedup; already-qualified DiT/connector/conditioning-cache defaults retained

limitations: One device under normal interactive use, two measured samples per arm; not a cross-machine guarantee.
Cold denotes prompt-cache state, not a cold OS page cache or first-ever shader compile.
Nested timings must not be summed; denoise includes stage1/stage2 and audio_decode includes VAE/vocoder/BWE.
The 12 GiB budget targets denoiser working set, not total process or system RAM. No new process-memory peak measurement is claimed.
Operator and single-block speedups are separate cohorts and cannot be multiplied or extrapolated to full video speed.
Matching decoded media establishes equality for this fixed request, not a perceptual evaluation across prompts.

desktop_package.signature: local ad-hoc; codesign --verify --deep --strict passed for all three App bundles
desktop_package.actual_model_generation: Same-package CLI, six full audio/video requests; App request conversion/worker/history covered by integration tests
